contract.scope: Direct level-1 HWPX rectangle and ellipse children of a top-level container. Parent IDs, other shape readers and general parse_u32 retain their compatibility path.
contract.parser: Use XML-normalized attribute text and parse xs:nonNegativeInteger spellings representable as u32, including ASCII XML whitespace around the integer, leading zeros, a leading plus and signed zero. Presence metadata distinguishes omission and explicit zero. Preserve alternate and unusable spellings and record parse failure separately from the numeric model value.
contract.ownership: An unusable child identifier prevents a complete group-child geometry ownership inventory, so groupChildGeometry, moveGroupChild and resizeGroupChild refuse that group. Duplicate numeric tuples, mismatched or stale ownership and fully zero target identities remain guarded.
contract.publication: The document loads when the XML is well formed. Both serializers escape and preserve the XML-normalized attribute value, including unusable values, without fabricating a valid zero. Independent reopen keeps the refusal. A clone assigned new IDs drops source spelling metadata, leaving the source intact.
contract.schema: Pinned RHWP OWPML ParaList XML schema.xml lines 1971 and 2263. XSD nonNegativeInteger is unbounded. 4294967296 is a schema value outside RHWP's u32 ownership range and is preserved without eligibility.
